depth_limit: ONE_FOCUSED_PASS — bind if strong; else record gap and move on
central_question: Can Arkansas bind AFIC@MCO / shared-kitchen operating statements, utilization, and fees in one focused pass — and if not, close the food-hub evidence stage at first-pass maturity without further drilling?

fee_schedule.facility: AFIC@MCO (Arkansas Food Innovation Center at Market Center of the Ozarks)
fee_schedule.related_afic_fayetteville_lab_fees_note: Separate AFIC (Fayetteville) publishes lab/process-authority fees (e.g. pH $20, Aw $30, process authority letter $200) — not AFIC@MCO P&L

utilization_and_operating_statement.found: Fee schedule and facility description only
not_found: utilization rate or booked hours series
utilization_and_operating_statement.uada_open_checkbook_note: UADA Open Checkbook provides Division expenditure transparency but is unaudited/raw and not an AFIC@MCO facility P&L — does not clear free-cash reconstruction.
utilization_and_operating_statement.implication: Fees prove a public/shared facility can charge for access. Fees without utilization and cost structure cannot produce COUNTABLE reserved public cash.

illustrative_revenue_note.rule: Hourly fees × unknown hours = speculation. Do not invent utilization.

stage_closure.book_architecture_posture: Arkansas produces enormous agricultural value, but currently available evidence does not establish the distributable cash generated by the proposed ownership model. Therefore, the model identifies food processing and value retention as a high-potential fiscal pathway while refusing to count speculative revenue. Facility-level validation becomes an implementation-stage requirement.
stage_closure.remaining_validation: IMPLEMENTATION_STAGE_GATE — not another research branch now

completion_priority.objective: BUILD THE COMPLETE SYSTEM → FINISH THE BOOK → identify gaps → stress-test → refine → implementation-grade validation
completion_priority.rejects: perfect one module → perfect another → discover three more questions → never finish

replacement_stack_feed.rule: Fee schedules are not reserved public cash

headline.reading: One-pass complete. AFIC@MCO fee schedule bound; utilization and P&L remain gaps. Food-hub evidence stage closed at first-pass maturity. Facility validation is an implementation gate. COUNTABLE $0. Advance the master build.
